title: Is It? No: Nothing, Nobody, Nowhere
label: ch:ja-is-it-no-nothing-nobody-nowhere
canDo: I can ask a yes-or-no question with ka, answer that something is not so, and say nothing, nobody and nowhere with a negative verb.

payoff.summary: Ask a yes-or-no question with desu ka, answer no with chigaimasu, say what is not so with ja nai, and say nothing, nobody and nowhere, each with a verb in -masen.
